import pytest

from jinja2.nativetypes import NativeEnvironment


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("template", "expected"),
    [
        # The original bug report
        (
            "{% block test %}{% for i in range(1) %}{{ loop.index }}{% endfor %}{% endblock %}{{ self.test() }}",
            1,
        ),
        # Ensure it works for multiple items
        (
            "{% block test %}{% for i in range(2) %}{{ loop.index }}{% endfor %}{% endblock %}{{ self.test() }}",
            "12",
        ),
        # Ensure it works for strings
        (
            "{% block test %}{% for i in range(1) %}{{ 'a' }}{% endfor %}{% endblock %}{{ self.test() }}",
            "a",
        ),
        # Ensure it works for mixed types
        (
            "{% block test %}{% for i in range(2) %}{% if loop.index == 1 %}{{ 1 }}{% else %}{{ 'b' }}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% endblock %}{{ self.test() }}",
            "1b",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_block_native_concat_loop_index(template, expected):
    env = NativeEnvironment()
    assert env.from_string(template).render() == expected
